notes.title: Release is coming
notes.notes:
🌟 Exciting News! 🌟

Mark your calendars for the sizzling release of "Just Date," my very FIRST adult game on November 15! We're meticulously perfecting every detail for your ultimate pleasure.

Your support and feedback on our demo were invaluable, and I'm immensely grateful. Stay tuned for the full release on November 15, where your desires and fantasies will come to life like never before.
